verdict.rationale: The API docs document a per-request retention control: setting enable_logging to false puts the request in zero retention mode, so users can choose not to have data retained. Nothing in the evidence covers deleting stored transcripts or audio, configurable retention periods, or account-level retention settings. Data residency and redaction are related privacy features but do not count as retention or deletion control. Missing for 10: documented deletion of stored transcripts/files, configurable retention windows or account-level policy, independent corroboration of zero-retention behavior.
